title: One, No One and One Hundred Thousand CTs: Testing Anatomical Control in Text-to-CT Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.33003v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advances in deep learning and the public availability of computed tomography (CT) datasets with paired reports have enabled many Text-to-CT generators. However, their evaluations almost always differ in preprocessing and metrics, which hinders comparison. Moreover, their protocols almost never test how editing the report changes the CT, not even at the same seed, so the report is often assumed to control the anatomy without evidence of how much and how consistently it does. We therefore propose CtrlCT, a toolkit that tests two properties of a generator, Credibility and Control. Credibility tests compare generated CTs, as a population, with real CTs and reports; Control tests are metamorphic and need no reference CT: at a fixed seed, editing one finding should change it as requested, keep negated findings absent and shift distant anatomy no more than a new seed, and the change should hold across seeds. translated_title: 一个、无人与十万个CT：测试文本到CT生成中的解剖学控制
translated_abstract: 深度学习的最新进展以及带有配对报告的计算机断层扫描（CT）数据集的公开可用性，催生了许多文本到CT（Text-to-CT）生成器。然而，这些生成器的评估在预处理和指标上几乎总是各不相同，阻碍了模型之间的比较。此外，它们的评估方案几乎从不测试编辑报告会如何改变生成的CT——即使在相同随机种子下也是如此——因此人们往往默认报告能够控制解剖结构，却缺乏关于其控制程度和一致性的证据。为此，我们提出了CtrlCT，一个用于测试生成器两种特性的工具包：可信度与控制力。可信度测试将生成的CT作为一个整体群体与真实CT和报告进行比较；控制力测试则是变形测试，无需参考CT：在固定随机种子下，编辑一个发现应按要求改变它，保持被否定的发现不存在，并且对远处解剖结构的影响不超过更换新随机种子所带来的变化，且这种改变应在不同种子间保持一致。一份报告卡总结了所有……（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出CtrlCT工具包，通过可信度测试（将生成CT与真实数据整体比较）和无需参考CT的变形式控制力测试（验证报告编辑能否按需、一致地控制解剖结构），解决了现有Text-to-CT生成器评估标准不一、且从未验证报告对解剖结构控制能力的核心问题。
en_tdlr: CtrlCT is a toolkit that evaluates Text-to-CT generators through Credibility tests (comparing generated CTs against real data) and reference-free metamorphic Control tests (verifying how reliably and consistently report edits control anatomy), addressing inconsistent evaluation protocols and the unverified assumption that reports control anatomy.
